items.en: «Тяжелые дроны – то, в чем нам нужно наверстывать упущенное» (Dva Mayora: 'Heavy drones — where we need to catch up')

items.en: Ukrainian brigade claims first frontline evacuation of a wounded soldier by heavy hexacopter drone
items.nl: Oekraïense brigade claimt eerste evacuatie van gewonde militair per zware hexacopter-drone
items.sEn: The unmanned ground systems company of Ukraine's 92nd Separate Assault Brigade says it has flown a wounded soldier off the front line with a heavy hexacopter drone, calling it the world's first aerial evacuation of a casualty from the battlefield.
